item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera reads about neutralisation in her Science class. Which statement about using neutralisation in daily life is not correct?

options.A: Rubbing a mild base such as baking soda on an ant bite can reduce the effect of the acid injected by the ant.
options.B: A farmer can add slaked lime to acidic soil to reduce its acidity before sowing crops.
options.C: Adding more acid to basic soil will make the soil even more basic.
options.D: A factory should treat its acidic waste water with a base before releasing it into a river.
